title: Switzerland Unbeaten in 6 Straight Matches Against Algeria
desc:
Switzerland are unbeaten in **6 consecutive meetings** against Algeria, recording 4 wins and 2 draws.
The Swiss have conceded just **3 goals** in that span while scoring first in 5 of the 6 clashes.
A clean sheet tonight would mark their longest defensive streak in head-to-head history.
evidence: Unbeaten in 6 meetings with 4 wins, 2 draws, and only 3 goals conceded.

title: Algeria Attack Averages 2.14 Goals Over 7-Game Surge
desc:
Algeria have scored **15 goals in their last 7 matches**, averaging 2.14 goals per match.
Their backline has conceded only **1 goal from open play** over the last 450 tournament minutes.
They enter this clash with 4 clean sheets in their last 5 outings.
evidence: 15 goals scored across their last 7 matches with 4 clean sheets recorded.

title: Opening Match Winner Holds 78% Knockout Advance Rate
desc:
Historically, **78% of teams** winning their opening tournament match advance directly to the knockouts.
A victory for Switzerland solidifies pole position for top-two qualification.
An Algerian upset blows the group wide open for the remaining two matchdays.
evidence: 78% of opening match winners advance to the tournament knockout phase.

title: Morocco Target Consecutive Historic Victories Over Portugal
desc:
Morocco can claim **consecutive competitive wins** over Portugal for the first time in their history.
Their iconic **1-0 quarter-final triumph** in Qatar remains their benchmark performance.
Portugal have failed to score against Morocco in their last 180 tournament minutes.
evidence: Won 1-0 in their last competitive meeting at the 2022 World Cup quarter-final.

title: Portugal On 9-Match Winning Run With 28 Goals Scored
desc:
Portugal arrive with **9 consecutive competitive victories**, scoring 28 goals and conceding just 3.
Their attack averages **3.11 goals per match**, creating over 4.2 big chances per 90.
They have kept 6 clean sheets during this 9-match dominant streak.
evidence: 9 consecutive competitive victories with 28 goals scored and 3 conceded.

title: Winner Claims #1 Seed Bracket Pathway in Group Stage
desc:
The winner of this clash takes **pole position for the #1 seed**, avoiding title contenders early.
A defeat forces the loser into a high-pressure survival scenario on Matchday 2.
Maximum 3 points tonight virtually guarantees knockout stage progression.
evidence: Winner secures #1 seed pathway in the tournament knockout bracket.
